description: This file defines the DebugProfiler class, which manages profiling and debugging information for the Goteo application, including event tracking, SQL query stats, session, and cookies.

classes.name: DebugProfiler
classes.description: A singleton class for profiling and debugging Goteo application events, SQL queries, sessions, and responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the profiler, sets up template folder, and starts the stopwatch.

methods.name: addKernelEvent
methods.description: Adds a kernel event to the profiler, capturing controller, request, and response info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the profiling data into a view, including SQL stats, events, session, cookies, and headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DebugProfiler.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Static method to add a kernel event.

methods.name: getHeadContent
methods.description: Returns the header content for the profiler.

methods.name: getBodyContent
methods.description: Returns the body content for the profiler.
